'''Calarantrum root''',<ref name="Dining at Dex's">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> was a thick orange or blue root that was used to add a touch of piquancy to [[bantha rump]] broth. Chef [[Gormaanda/Legends|Gormaanda]] provided instructional [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]] including tips on how to properly use this food additive for various meals. Gormaanda also used calarantrum seeds for her [[Glowblue Noodles and Chav]] dish.

Calarantrum was also used as an ingredient in the recipe for the [[gartro egg omelet]], a dish that could be purchased from the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] dining establishment [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]] used liberal helpings of calarantrum root when preparing a special [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] "[[Bantha rump|bantha surprise]]" dinner for her husband, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>
